_note: Official NEPRA documents Rehnuma answers from. `rehnuma-policy fetch` downloads them into data/policy/raw/ (git-ignored) and records a SHA-256 in sources.lock.json; a changed hash on a later fetch means NEPRA replaced the file and the answer layer must be reviewed. `status` and `amends` let answers warn when a clause has been repealed or amended.

documents.title: NEPRA (Alternative & Renewable Energy) Distributed Generation and Net Metering Regulations, 2015 - S.R.O. 892(I)/2015
documents.note: Repealed by the Prosumer Regulations 2026, but agreements signed under it keep their export price until the agreement term ends (Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 21(2)).
